prompt:
Use the table in the image. It shows a spreadsheet-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, full grid lines, and a shaded header row. Use the table values to filter the rows and then identify the winning row in the named target column. Using only the rows with values in Dist greater than 10, determine which row has the minimum value in Mass.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact row-name string from the filtered rows.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":"Milo"}
